question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Fragile**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context provided, the sentence contrasts the hardness and strength of trees with the softness and fragility of paper. 
 
• "**Fragile**" is the best fit because it emphasizes the delicate nature of paper, which contrasts with the hard and strong characteristics of trees.
 
• "**Healthy**" does not provide the appropriate contrast with "hard and strong." While trees can be healthy, it doesn't contribute to the intended contrast in the sentence.
 
• "**Dashing**" means stylish or attractive, which is unrelated to the characteristics being compared in the sentence.
 
• "**Awful**" means extremely bad or unpleasant, which is not relevant to the comparison of the qualities of trees and paper.​

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

**Complete paragraph: **Everyone (1) ***knows***__ that paper is made from trees. But when one looks at trees, one cannot imagine that something as soft and (2)__***fragile***__ as paper is made from a tree that is so hard and strong. Plant materials such as wood are made of fibers known as cellulose. Cellulose is the primary (3) ________ in papermaking. Raw wood is first (4) ________ into pulp, which consists of a mixture of cellulose, lignin, water, and some chemicals. The pulp can be made mechanically through grinders or through chemical processes. The paper (5) ________ in this way is weak and is used to make newspapers, magazines, and phonebooks.
